database.crud_mcp: none (Data API builder has no REST for Cosmos NoSQL; NCAMEO framework serves REST)

environment.NP_AGENT_BASE_URL: Base URL of the backend agent
environment.NP_DAB_MCP_URL: URL of the CRUD MCP server used by the agent
environment.NCAMEO_COSMOSACCOUNT: Cosmos DB account name (DataSource record cosmosaccount)
environment.NCAMEO_COLLECTION: Cosmos DB collection name for the DataSource record
environment.NCAMEO_PARTITIONKEY: Cosmos DB partition key path (generate-db default /pk)
environment.NCAMEO_ACCESSKEY: Cosmos DB primary key - secret, referenced as ${NCAMEO_ACCESSKEY}, never written
